programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Sloths – famous around the world for their slow pace of life – are under threat. In Suriname, their numbers are falling at a staggering rate as their forest habitat is transformed into towns and roads. Since 2005, Monique Pool, nicknamed the Sloth Lady, has been working tirelessly to protect this unique species with a shelter for injured sloths and an area of forest protected from development to ensure that the local sloths have a safe place to live. Get up close with this amazing animal as she rescues sloths from urban areas, nurses injured sloths back to full health and releases them back into the forest.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Uncommon and hardly known, today the Dugong is the most threatened sea mammal on the planet. programme.title: Tim Young
programme.desc: Tim headlines clubs all over North America, has performed on over 500 college campuses as well as comedy festivals in New York, Montreal, and Seattle, and he's a fixture in the New York City club scene. He was a finalist on NBCs Last Comic Standing, has appeared on Comedy Centrals Premium Blend, Tough Crowd, and Shorties, and you may have seen him as a commentator on VH1, MTV, TLC and the E! Channel.

programme.title: Brad Upton
programme.desc: Brad Upton first stepped on stage in September of 1984 and he's never looked back. This ex-grade school teacher is now in his 30th year of comedy and is nearing 6000 lifetime performances. He is a past winner of the Las Vegas Comedy Festival and appeared recently at Caesar's Palace as part of the HBO Comedy Festival. He has spent the last eight years as the opening act for the legendary Johnny Mathis and did multiple shows all over the country with the late, great Joan Rivers. He has also been seen in concert with The Smothers Brothers, Smokey Robinson, Kenny Rogers, Dolly Parton, Lewis Black, George Jones, Glen Campbell, Pam Tillis and many others. Coast to coast all over North America isn't the only place Brad performs. In 2014 Brad headlined in Singapore, Hong Kong, The MGM in Macau and did eight nights in Israel as part of the Comedy for Koby benefit. His new CD entitled, "Brad Uptonogood" is heard regularly on Sirius Satellite Radio and is available online wherever music is sold. He also just released his first DVD entitled, "Brad Upton, Live from the 509".

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Andy Woodhull
programme.desc: Andy recently appeared on Conan on TBS. Around that same time, his half-hour special premiered on Comedy Central. He was the first comedian to make his network television debut on “The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon”. He also appeared on Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, and Gotham Comedy Live on AXS. He had also appeared on Comedy Central's “Live at Gotham” in 2009.

programme.title: Cory Michaelis
programme.desc: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they're in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), the 2012 Seattle International Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comedy Contest (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

programme.title: Kristin Key
programme.desc: Kristin Key grew up a minister's daughter in a small town in West Texas. Much like Footloose, she was raised in a no-drinking, no-dancing, no instrumental music environment. She seemed like any other well-behaved girl… until she opened her mouth. It was obvious from the beginning that she had a quick wit and undeniable sense of humor.

programme.title: Tommy Drake
programme.desc: Tommy's unique mixture of original material delivered in a classic style has given him the opportunity to do more shows and be seen by more people live than just about any other comic on the planet.

programme.title: Chad Thornsberry
programme.desc: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling. Chad's unique comedic perspective awards audience the opportunity to laugh at the common occurrences in everyday life. Often referred to as a great writer, his straightforward style allows audiences to laugh with him and at him as they find the humor in themselves. With reflections on growing up in a trailer park and observations as an English teacher, Chad's satiric insights look at the pitfalls that make us human. With smart humor and a conversational style, Chad has delighted audiences from the trailer park, throughout the Midwest, and from coast to coast.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Now You See It, Now You Don’t"
programme.sub-title: Now You See It, Now You Don’t
programme.desc: Delve into the stealthy world of animal camouflage to see how expertly disguised creatures blend into their environments.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Little Mammals"
programme.desc: In this episode we meet some of the zoo’s little mammals. The serval is due for his annual health check. The crew saved a porcupine from a very sticky situation. And the meerkats are given a chance to play with their food.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Reptiles and Amphibians"
programme.desc: In this episode we meet some of the zoo’s most cold-blooded residents, the reptiles and amphibians and discover why they still inspire fear in some of the world’s toughest creatures.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Mokopane Biodiversity and Conservation Centre"
programme.desc: In this episode we explore the zoo’s satellite breeding facility, the Mokopane Biodiversity and Conservation Centre. We meet Johannes, part of the zoo crew and see why he has such a special relationship with the animals he cares for.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "The Aquarium"
programme.desc: In this episode two juvenile ragged tooth sharks travel from the Two Oceans Aquarium in Cape to make their home at City Zoo, but will they settle in? While Adrian performs surgery on a slippery patient, a tropical fish.

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Antelope"
programme.desc: In this episode we follow the zoo crew as they work with the antelope. The team dart and capture Lechwe, but things start going wrong when one of the animals reacts badly to the tranquilizer.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "ELITE CORPS"
programme.desc: Survival demands an edge. Witness some of the animals whose elite sensory abilities put them at the top of their game.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "NAVY SEALS"
programme.desc: In the water, it takes sophisticated navigation systems, fine-tuned reflexes, and high-precision detection methods to survive. These animals have what it takes.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "PATROL"
programme.desc: Life in the wild is life during wartime, and these animal soldiers have mastered the tactics of surveillance, stealth, and attack.

programme.title: Bear Whisperer S1 - "Episode 01"
programme.desc: In Mammoth Lakes, Steve Searles uses non-lethal tactics to manage human-bear conflicts and ensure both species coexist safely during peak season.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S3 - "Endangered:Say Hello, Say Goodbye"
programme.desc: Explore the causes of animal extinction, from habitat loss to hunting. This look at dwindling populations reveals what it truly means to be endangere

programme.title: Animal Atlas S3 - "Animal Passport:Africa!"
programme.desc: From massive elephants to quirky meerkats, discover the diverse wildlife of Africa and the fascinating behaviors of its most iconic inhabitants.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S3 - "Nine Giraffes"
programme.desc: Take an intimate look at the world’s tallest land mammal to uncover the secrets behind its massive size and unique biological adaptations.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Europe’s Coolest Creatures"
programme.desc: Discover some of Europe’s most incredible creatures! Learn why the mongoose is immune to cobra venom, and how the dragonfly uses 80% of its brain just to process what it sees.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Asia’s Coolest Creatures"
programme.desc: Explore some of the most extraordinary creatures from Asia! Discover how the snow leopard survives in the rugged Himalayan Mountains, and learn why the Komodo dragon is the largest lizard on Earth.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Animals of the Land and Sea"
programme.sub-title: Animals of the Land and Sea
programme.desc: Explore a fascinating mix of animals from both land and sea! Discover why the seahorse moves like an underwater hummingbird, and learn how the Thomson’s gazelle can outmaneuver a cheetah in a race for survival.

programme.title: Nature's calendar S1 - "January"
programme.desc: For some animals January is a time of lush plenty, for others babies are on their way. From the pine martens that frolic in snowy northern wonderlands to capybara finally released from the Amazon’s dry season to a river swelling with watery life.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S1 - "Get Your Goat"
programme.desc: Clayton visits a "franch" to determine if Ibex the Goat is a good candidate for a brace. Zachery Lee accompanies his owner everywhere—even to her salon—so he needs a brace to get back to work by her side.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Lumps, Jabs and Tiny Patients"
programme.desc: The team treats Labrador Scuby’s lumps, nervous cat Wotzit’s jabs, rescue collie Bob, and tiny rat Squeaky’s stomach growth in a day of unusual cases.

programme.title: Wild Ones S1 - "MASTERS OF THE SKY"
programme.desc: Wild Ones draws inspiration from the rhythms of nature, delving into the wonders of the animal kingdom. This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Reefs of Steel"
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them!

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Shark Nation"
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Shipwreck Exploration in the Bahamas"
programme.desc: The Blue World team goes to Florida to assist in the annual Florida Manatee health assessments conducted by the U.S. Geological Service. Then they explore a shipwreck in the Bahamas.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Mysterious Nocturnal Creatures in the Philippines"
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Nocturnal Creatures in the Philippines

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Elusive Pajama Squid in South Australia"
programme.sub-title: Elusive Pajama Squid in South Australia
programme.desc: Blue World goes hunting for the rare and elusive Pajama Squid on a night dive off a South Australian jetty. Then correspondent “Cameraman Bill” experiences an ice dive at a frozen lake in New Hampshire.

programme.title: To The Rescue S1 - "A Rescue's Journey"
programme.desc: Tommy tracks dogs traveling hundreds of miles as a network of dedicated volunteers works together to make a long-awaited adoption day possible.

programme.title: To The Rescue S1 - "Rescue Rookies"
programme.desc: This week spotlights newcomers, from families adopting for the first time to rookie volunteers and fosters embracing their life-changing new roles.

programme.title: To The Rescue S1 - "Limits Unleashed"

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.desc: ¡El Arca de Shinato de Noé roba monstruos en su fortaleza para usarlos como un muro impenetrable de sirvientes!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está a punto de acabar con Noah, ¡pero Mokuba protege a Noah de su golpe final!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La amenaza final de Noah: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi, harto de la traición de Noah, toma el lugar de Kaiba en el duelo. Sin embargo, en cada turno que pasa, uno de los amigos de Yugi se transforma en piedra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La amenaza final de Noah: Parte 2
programme.desc: Uno a uno, todos los amigos de Yugi se van convirtiendo en sólidas estatuas de piedra. Pero aunque la pandilla esté congelada, ¡sus espíritus siguen vivos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha derrotado a Noah, pero siguen sin poder escapar del mundo virtual. Se revela la verdadera razón detrás de su trampa... ¡así como el verdadero villano que mueve los hilos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un misil destruirá la base submarina en treinta minutos, pero nuestros héroes siguen atrapados dentro y no pueden escapar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba se enfrenta a Gozaburo -y a sus propios demonios- para intentar conquistar por fin su doloroso pasado, pero ¿cómo podrá Kaiba derrotar a la Exodia Necross de Gozaburo, que no puede ser destruido por hechizos, trampas o ni siquiera ataques?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos llegan a la isla de KaibaCorp, donde los finalistas de la Ciudad de la Batalla competirán en la arena de duelo definitiva, la majestuosa Torre del Duelo que se extiende cientos de metros en las nubes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 2
programme.desc: Honor, amistad, venganza... Mientras cada uno de los duelistas recuerda por qué está luchando, la batalla real se desata y ninguno de los duelistas sabe de dónde vendrá el próximo ataque.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 3
programme.desc: Joey ha librado algunos de los combates más encarnizados de la Ciudad de la Batalla, pero ¿le ha enseñado todo su entrenamiento en primera línea a convertirse en un duelista de élite, o sigue estando por debajo de los tres grandes de Duelo de Monstruos?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik atrapa a Joey en un Juego de Sombras en el que el corazón de cada duelista está vinculado a sus monstruos... ¡Literalmente! Cada vez que un monstruo recibe daño, ¡el duelista siente el dolor en su lugar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El Helpoemer de Marik no solo envía las cartas poderosas de Joey al cementerio antes de que él pueda utilizarlas, sino que además, Joey sufre dolor por cada monstruo que va al cementerio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapado y a punto de morir, Joey cree que este duelo no puede empeorar. ¡Pero Marik tiene todas las piezas para invocar al Dragón Alado de Ra! ¿Podrá Joey evitar que Marik invoque la carta del dios egipcio o simplemente la victoria no está en las cartas?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik transforma al Dragón Alado de Ra en su poderosa forma, ¡el dios egipcio Fénix! Si Joey no puede resistir las llamas infernales del fuego abrasador del Fénix, se quemará y perderá el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la revancha que todos estábamos esperando. Yugi y Kaiba se enfrentan por primera vez desde el Reino de los Duelistas ante miles de ávidos fans para ganar el derecho a desafiar a Marik. ¡Es la hora del duelo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba combina la amenaza magnética XYZ-Cañón del Dragón para obtener un poder de ataque inigualable, pero Yugi solo tiene un humilde Caballero de la Reina para protegerse.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡La batalla entre los dioses egipcios ha comenzado! Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi va a enfrentarse a Obelisco el Atormentador de Kaiba, ¿qué ocurrirá cuando dos dioses egipcios luchen entre sí? ¡Es hora de averiguar qué Dios egipcio es más fuerte!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El enfrentamiento de los dos dioses egipcios libera energías místicas que muestran a Yugi y Kaiba visiones del antiguo pasado egipcio. ¿Qué nuevas respuestas desvelan estas imágenes y qué profecías hacen para el futuro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba invoca tres poderosos Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules, pero a Yugi no le queda ningún monstruo en el mazo que pueda resistir su poder. ¿La derrota de Yugi es inminente o una carta de un amigo caído le ayudará a cambiar las tornas de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba no solo controla al Dragón Definitivo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo que utilizó para derrotar a Yugi en el Reino de los Duelistas, sino que su carta de Órdenes de Ataque Final deja a Yugi con solo tres cartas en su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 1
programme.desc: Cansado de los insultos de Kaiba, Joey desafía a Kaiba para conseguir el tercer puesto en el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla. ¿Habrá dominado Joey suficientes estrategias para acabar con el mandamás o Kaiba machacará a Joey como a un patético cachorro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 2
programme.desc: Kaiba ataca con su poderoso Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, pero Joey no tiene monstruos con los que defenderse. La suerte de Joey se ha agotado. ¡Es hora de que confíe en su habilidad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 3
programme.desc: La batalla entre Joey y Kaiba llega a su clímax y el resultado del duelo depende de un último giro de la rueda del Mago del Tiempo. ¿Conseguirá Joey acabar con su mayor dolor de cabeza y enseñarle a Kaiba cómo ser un verdadero duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es el enfrentamiento decisivo de la Ciudad de la Batalla y el destino del mundo está en juego: ¡Yami Yugi contra Marik! En este retorcido Juego de Sombras, si Yami Yugi pierde, se ira de vacaciones permanentes al Reino de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik demuestra que su Dragón Alado de Ra es la carta de dioses egipcios más fuerte al destruir a Slifer el Dragón del Cielo. Ninguna de las cartas de Yugi puede resistir su implacable ataque. Un regalo de Kaiba puede ser la clave para cambiar el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es Obelisco el Atormentador contra... ¿Obelisco el Atormentador? Yugi no puede golpear los puntos de vida de Marik porque el indestructible dios egipcio Baba de Marik resucita en cada turno.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Ni siquiera con la fuerza de ataque infinita de Obelisco el Atormentador, puede Yugi derrotar al Dragón Alado de Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik ha destruido a Slifer el Dragón del Cielo y a Obelisco el Atormentador.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La isla de KaibaCorp va a explotar en unos minutos, pero los motores del dirigible están desconectados. Por si fuera poco, Kaiba y Mokuba no aparecen por ningún lado. ¿Podrán Yugi y sus amigos escapar de la isla a tiempo o se hundirán en el fondo del mar?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa y Serenity recorren la ciudad del Domino y rememoran las batallas de sus amigos durante la Ciudad de la Batalla. Ahí se dan cuenta de cuánto han madurado y de lo lejos que han llegado... ¡Y de lo mucho que les queda por recorrer!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos están fascinados con las cartas de Duelo de Monstruos del abuelo, pero cuando el duelista número 1 y el despiadado magnate secuestran al abuelo para conseguir la carta del Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, Yugi deberá enfrentarse a Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos se toman un descanso de perfeccionamiento de sus técnicas de juego de cartas para ver a Larva y Rex Raptor competir en el Campeonato Regional de Duelo de Monstruos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos se toman un descanso de perfeccionamiento de sus técnicas de juego de cartas para ver a Larva y Rex Raptor competir en el Campeonato Regional de Duelo de Monstruos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Rumbo al Reino de los Duelistas
programme.desc: Yugi renuncia a una de sus propias Fichas Estelares para que Joey pueda subir al barco con destino al Reino de los Duelistas y batirse en duelo para salvar la vista de su hermana, mientras Téa y Tristán van de polizones para reunirse con sus amigos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Rumbo al Reino de los Duelistas
programme.desc: Yugi renuncia a una de sus propias Fichas Estelares para que Joey pueda subir al barco con destino al Reino de los Duelistas y batirse en duelo para salvar la vista de su hermana, mientras Téa y Tristán van de polizones para reunirse con sus amigos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Una vez que Yugi y sus amigos llegan al Reino de los Duelistas, Pegasus anuncia que hay muchos secretos extraños en la isla que harán que su último torneo sea diferente a todos los que han conocido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después de derrotar la primera oleada de monstruos de duelo de Larva, Yugi se sorprende al descubrir que Larva tiene un último truco bajo la manga: ¡una voraz Gran Polilla que se vuelve más poderosa con cada turno.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca un oponente de duelo al que pueda vencer y acaba aceptando valientemente un reto de la veterana duelista Mai.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El pescador duelista y maestro de la baraja marina atrae a Yugi a un duelo en su propio campo de juego marino para obtener una ventaja de campo. ¿Podrá Yugi adaptarse a estos nuevos escenarios para cambiar las tornas de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Si Yugi es eliminado del torneo, la malvada Junta Directiva de KaibaCorp entregará el control de la compañía a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi debe batirse en duelo con un doble mágico de Kaiba creado a partir de la codicia y la sed de poder que Yugi le borró del alma. Yugi tendrá que descubrir una estrategia para sobrevivir al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi derrota al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, ¡pero hay dos más esperando en las alas! ¿Llegará el verdadero Kaiba hasta Yugi a tiempo para ayudar a vencer a este imitador?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide luchar contra Rex Raptor sin la ayuda de sus amigos para demostrar que es lo suficientemente hombre como para cuidar de Serenity por sí mismo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se bate con valentía, pero Rex Raptor ha desatado su arma secreta: ¡el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos! Joey debe descubrir el secreto del regalo de Yugi, la carta del Mago del Tiempo o tendrá que irse del Reino de los Duelistas en el próximo barco.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura, el compañero de clase de Yugi, poseído por los poderes oscuros de su Anillo del Milenio, atrapa a Yugi y a sus amigos en un Juego de Sombras en el que ellos se convierten en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La luz la final del túnel
programme.desc: PaniK le quita a Mai todas sus Fichas Estelares, y Yugi jura derrotarlo y recuperarlas. Pero con el Castillo de las Ilusiones Oscuras de PaniK rodeado de una niebla negra, ¿cómo podrá Yugi derrotar a un enemigo que no puede ver?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba baja al reino para enfrentarse a Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su batalla con Yugi o sigue siendo un duelista despiadado? Una batalla entre el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba y el Dragón B de Ojos Rojos de Joey tiene las respuestas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 1
programme.desc: La banda del duelista americano número 1, Bandido Keith, secuestra a Joey y lo lleva a una cueva con un campo de juego en forma de cementerio. Joey se enfrenta a los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith, que se hacen más fuertes al volver de la tumba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 2
programme.desc: El último recurso de Joey, su carta de suerte del Mago del Tiempo, fracasa contra los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith. Su racha de suerte llega a su fin, ¿podrán sus mejores habilidades como duelista y el amor por su hermana impulsarlo a la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Era la noche anterior a la batalla final, ¡y muchas criaturas se agitan! Yugi jura derrocar a Pegaso por el bien de su abuelo. Tristán lidera un grupo de exploración para descubrir los secretos de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai se ha recuperado de su anterior derrota contra Joey convirtiéndose en una mejor duelista. ¿Ha aprendido Yugi de su derrota contra Kaiba, o la derrota emocional sigue pesando en su corazón? La respuesta está en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 1
programme.desc: Orgulloso de su fuerza como duelista en el juego, Joey desafía a Yugi para tener derecho a enfrentarse a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.
